_readme: playlist = what gets played, in order. Edit freely, restart the server after.

Types: fibbage | number | pick | image (everyone writes an AI picture prompt; players are split into groups of ~4 and each group gets one of the 'prompts'; Grandma judges later) | gallery (shows the pictures group by group: each picture, a vote, crowd favorite + Grandma's pick, then the next group) | photo | slide.

Per-question options: timer (seconds, overrides the default), double: true (double points), tone: 'guess' (phones say 'write what you think she said' instead of 'write a lie', for the meaningful ones), options: [...] for pick questions.
pick questions with no options use pickOptions from game/config.json. PUT HER 12 KIDS' NAMES THERE. If that is empty too, it falls back to the players' names.
Put the image question 2 questions before the gallery so the AI has time to draw (about 15 to 30 seconds per picture, 3 at a time).
spares = more questions to swap in. Roughly 70% funny, 30% meaningful.

image items: use 'prompts' (a list, one per group, reused in order if there are more groups) and 'prompt' (what the TV says). Put the gallery 2-4 questions later so the AI has time (about 20s per picture, 3 at a time: 16 pictures ~ 2 minutes).

Picture round. Each group creates the picture that best describes their theme.
prompts: The picture that best describes: Grandma at her most chaotic
